channel.title: The Life And Times Of Sister Faustina
channel.desc: Born in Poland in 1905 as Helena Kowalska, she is now known as Blessed Sister Mary Faustina, "The Apostle of Divine Mercy." Fr. Seraphim Michalenko Vice-Postulator for the cause of Canonization for Blessed Faustina for North America, explains in detail this re-enactment of Blessed Faustina?s life and the Divine Mercy Novena. (60 minutes).
